map.质数（素数）只能被 1 和自身整除。本工具用试除法判定是否为质数，并对合数给出分: A prime number is divisible only by 1 and itself. This tool uses trial division to test primality and factors composites, making it handy for learning number theory and for verification.
map.判断一个数是否为质数。: Determine whether a number is prime.
map.：大于 1 且除 1 与自身外没有其他正因数的整数。: : an integer greater than 1 with no positive divisors other than 1 and itself.
map.：检查 2 到 √n 之间是否存在因子，复杂度 O(√n)。: : check whether any factor exists between 2 and √n, with complexity O(√n).
map.：先判 2，之后只测奇数；除 2 与 3 外，质数必出现在 6k±1 位置。: : test 2 first, then only odd numbers; apart from 2 and 3, every prime lies at a position of the form 6k±1.
map.：通常使用 Miller-Rabin 概率素性检验，确定性判定需选取固定的测试基: : the Miller-Rabin probabilistic primality test is usually used; a deterministic result requires a fixed set of test bases.
map.质数大于 1 且只有 1 和自身两个正因数；2 是唯一偶质数，其余质数均为奇数。: A prime is greater than 1 and has only two positive divisors, 1 and itself; 2 is the only even prime and all others are odd.
map.试除法只需检查到 √n 即可：若到 √n 都没有因数，更大因数必成对出现，无需继: Trial division only needs to go up to √n: if there is no factor by then, any larger factor must come in a pair, so there is no need to continue.
map.因数分解对密码学（RSA）至关重要，但大数分解在计算上极难，这正是公钥加密的安全: Integer factorization is central to cryptography (RSA), yet factoring large numbers is computationally very hard — which is precisely the basis of public-key security.
map.判断大整数是否为素数，教学与密码学前置。: Test whether a large integer is prime — for teaching and as a cryptography prerequisite.
map.验证密钥参数或教学演示：检查一个候选数是否为素数，理解为何密钥生成必须使用大素数: Verify key parameters or demonstrate in class: check whether a candidate is prime and understand why key generation must use large primes.
map.97 不能被 2..√97≈9 的素数整除 → 是素数；91=7·13 → 合数: 97 is not divisible by any prime from 2 up to √97≈9 → prime; 91=7·13 → composite.
map.超过一定规模用 Miller-Rabin 等概率素性测试。: Beyond a certain size, probabilistic tests such as Miller-Rabin are used.
map.为什么大数判定要很久？: Why does testing large numbers take so long?
map.因为要排除的因子随位数指数增长：试除法需检查到 √n，一个 20 位的数就要试上: Because the factors to rule out grow exponentially with the number of digits: trial division has to go up to √n, so a 20-digit number requires tens of billions of attempts. Practical algorithms switch to probabilistic tests (Miller-Rabin, which reaches very high confidence in a few dozen rounds for large numbers) or their deterministic variants. That is also why key generation itself is slow.
